questions.question: Should I watch PR #1085 for CI results and review comments, and fix failures as they come in?

options.label: Watch and autofix (Recommended)
options.description: I subscribe to the PR's events. On a red CI run or a review comment I diagnose, validate locally, and push fixes until it is green. This run is the first of the new workflow config, so a failure is plausible.

options.label: Watch, report only
options.description: I subscribe and tell you what failed or what reviewers asked, but push nothing without your go.

options.label: Don't watch
options.description: No subscription. You drive the PR yourself, e.g. with /rvw-pr and /fix-pr.
